entity_raw.definition_raw:
You can avoid the need for thought components by trusting your instincts.

Benefit(s): An intuitive spell can be cast with no thought components. Spells without thought components are not affected.

Level Increase: +1 (an intuitive spell uses up a spell slot 1 level higher than the spell’s actual level.
